description: Recommend streaming Semiotic charts for a schema (not row data). Pass fields plus optional throughput (band or rows/sec), retention, shape ('append'|'keyed'|'aggregate'), and keyFields. Ranks realtime XY charts plus push-capable ordinal/value charts (BarChart, PieChart, BigNumber, GaugeChart, …). Returns suggestions, excluded fits-reasons, and optional stretch picks when audience is set.

schema.description: Stream schema — fields plus throughput/retention/shape hints. No row data.

name: suggestStreamCharts
